messages.subject: binomial mixture models?
parts:
Dear all,


I am trying to convert a winbugs code into inla code. In particular I am interested in binomial-mixture models such as those described in the Kery & Shaub book (Bayesian Population Analysis using WinBUGS- chapter 12), but I am getting confused if this is possible in inla.


I short I have replicated population counts over a number of sites and I want to separate the ecological process – Ni~Poisson(lambda)- from the observation model - yij|Ni~Binomial (Ni,p)-


Can somebody show me a starting point?

Best

Giac
